detailed_description: YouTube Thumbnail Generator extracts the 11-character YouTube video ID from a watch URL, Shorts URL, embed URL, youtu.be link, or raw ID, then builds public thumbnail URLs for maxresdefault.jpg, hqdefault.jpg, mqdefault.jpg, and default.jpg. The page previews each image and lets you copy or open the exact thumbnail URL.
usage_steps: Paste a YouTube watch, Shorts, embed, youtu.be URL, or raw 11-character video ID.
Confirm the extracted video ID shown above the preview grid.
Review the max resolution, high quality, medium quality, and default thumbnail variants.
Copy the thumbnail URL you need or open it in a new tab.
usage_examples: Check whether maxresdefault.jpg exists for a video before using it in a content plan.
Copy hqdefault.jpg for a lightweight editorial preview or social planning sheet.
Compare public thumbnail variants when auditing a YouTube video page.

faqs.question: Is YouTube Thumbnail Generator free?
faqs.answer: Yes. The tool is free to use in your browser and does not require an account.

faqs.question: Does the tool upload my inputs?
faqs.answer: No. The tool only extracts the video ID locally and builds public YouTube image URLs.

faqs.question: Does this download or proxy the thumbnail image?
faqs.answer: No. It generates the public YouTube thumbnail image URLs and previews them directly in your browser.

faqs.question: Which thumbnail sizes are shown?
faqs.answer: The tool shows maxresdefault.jpg, hqdefault.jpg, mqdefault.jpg, and default.jpg for the extracted video ID.
